description: Which rows of JA (a = 1, 2, Null, 4; g = x, y, z, x) pass IN and NOT IN with a value list containing Null, an empty list, mixed Long/Text and fractional members, a Null left side, a duplicate member, a column inside the list, a Text list over case-different members, and a row-value form; what do the projected IN and NOT IN give with a Null in the list; and the same IN and NOT IN over a subquery on JB.b (with a Null), with and without its Null removed and over a UNION child? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
